##### Project general facts 

Elevia Residences 3 is a distinguished residential development by Valores, a collaboration between one of the UAE's largest contractors and a leading property management expert, delivering a community that transforms real estate into a true living sanctuary. The project offers a thoughtfully curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, all designed with sleek modern architecture and impeccable craftsmanship in the vibrant community. Every space has been meticulously planned to balance ultimate comfort, functionality, and long-term investment value, making it an exceptional choice for both homeowners and savvy investors alike.

Residents of Elevia Residences 3 enjoy a well-rounded lifestyle with access to a luxurious swimming pool, a fully equipped state-of-the-art gym, and a safe and engaging children's play area. Secure covered parking provides residents with convenient, hassle-free access to their homes every day. The development's proximity to a fresh fruits and vegetables market, world-class shopping destinations, and Academic City's vast university cluster places every essential and leisure need within effortless reach.

The interiors of Elevia Residences 3 reflect a refined modern aesthetic, with sleek finishes and high-quality materials carefully selected to create spaces that feel both luxurious and enduring. Living areas are bright and well-proportioned, designed to maximise functionality while maintaining a sophisticated residential character throughout. The overall finish quality speaks to Valores' commitment to craftsmanship and detail, ensuring every home delivers a premium living experience from the moment of handover.

##### Location description and benefits

Warsan 4 is a dynamic and well-established residential community in Dubai, characterised by wide roads, lush greenery, and a welcoming neighbourhood atmosphere that appeals to families, professionals, and students alike. The area enjoys a calm suburban feel while remaining deeply connected to the urban energy of the wider city. Its thoughtfully planned streetscape and community infrastructure make it one of Dubai's most liveable and accessible everyday destinations.

The community sits at a highly strategic point in Dubai's urban framework, placing residents within easy reach of the city's premier shopping malls, Dubai International Airport, and the bustling employment and business districts that drive the emirate's economy. Academic City, home to a remarkable concentration of leading universities, is virtually on the doorstep, making the location particularly attractive to students and educators. The anticipated Metro Blue Line will further elevate the area's connectivity, reinforcing its status as one of Dubai's most well-linked residential communities.

Warsan 4 represents one of Dubai's most compelling value propositions, offering affordable, high-quality urban living in a location that continues to attract growing demand from residents and investors. The community's direct access to employment hubs, academic institutions, and transport infrastructure ensures consistently strong rental appeal and long-term occupancy. For investors seeking maximum returns in a city that never stops growing, Warsan 4 stands out as a neighbourhood whose best days are firmly ahead of it.
